question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Gigantic
solution:
The correct answer is: **Huge**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Gigantic"** means something extremely large in size, scale, or degree. (विशालकाय)

 
 
• **Example:** The gigantic skyscraper towered over the city, visible for miles around.
 
 
 
• **"Huge"** is a synonym of gigantic and also means very large in size or extent. (बहुत बड़ा)
 
 
• **Example:** The football stadium was huge, capable of seating over 80,000 spectators.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the most appropriate synonym for **"Gigantic"** is **"Huge"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Huge**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Fragile** (नाजुक): Easily broken or damaged; delicate.

 
 
• **Example:** The fragile glass vase shattered as soon as it hit the floor.
 
 
 
• **Rough** (खुरदरा): Having an uneven or irregular surface; coarse.
 
 
• **Example:** The rough texture of the fabric was uncomfortable against the skin.
 
 
 
• **Tiny** (छोटा): Extremely small in size or amount.
 
 
• **Example:** The tiny ant struggled to carry the large crumb back to its nest.
 
 

3c:Tdeb,

योग्य उत्तर आहे: **Huge**.
